from solution import change_date_format


def test_issue_example():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=2026 mm=01 dd=02 => dd-mm-yyyy = 02-01-2026
    assert change_date_format("2026-01-02") == "02-01-2026"


def test_issue_end_of_year():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=2000 mm=12 dd=31 => dd-mm-yyyy = 31-12-2000
    assert change_date_format("2000-12-31") == "31-12-2000"


def test_issue_start_of_year():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=1999 mm=01 dd=01 => dd-mm-yyyy = 01-01-1999
    assert change_date_format("1999-01-01") == "01-01-1999"


def test_issue_leap_day():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=2024 mm=02 dd=29 => dd-mm-yyyy = 29-02-2024
    assert change_date_format("2024-02-29") == "29-02-2024"


def test_issue_october_date():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=2025 mm=10 dd=05 => dd-mm-yyyy = 05-10-2025
    assert change_date_format("2025-10-05") == "05-10-2025"


def test_issue_mid_century():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=1970 mm=06 dd=15 => dd-mm-yyyy = 15-06-1970
    assert change_date_format("1970-06-15") == "15-06-1970"


def test_issue_min_year_zero_padded():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=0001 mm=01 dd=01 => dd-mm-yyyy = 01-01-0001
    assert change_date_format("0001-01-01") == "01-01-0001"


def test_issue_max_year():
    """Convert yyyy-mm-dd format to dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # yyyy=9999 mm=12 dd=31 => dd-mm-yyyy = 31-12-9999
    assert change_date_format("9999-12-31") == "31-12-9999"


def test_contract_returns_str():
    """Output is dd-mm-yyyy string."""
    # input 2026-01-02 => output 02-01-2026, length 10 = 2+1+2+1+4
    assert isinstance(change_date_format("2026-01-02"), str)


def test_contract_length_ten():
    """Output is dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # input 2001-09-08 => output 08-09-2001, length 10 = 2+1+2+1+4
    assert len(change_date_format("2001-09-08")) == 10  # 2+1+2+1+4 = 10


def test_contract_dash_separators():
    """Output uses dd-mm-yyyy format."""
    # input 2020-12-15 => output 15-12-2020, dashes at index 2 and 5
    assert change_date_format("2020-12-15")[2] == "-" and change_date_format("2020-12-15")[5] == "-"
